HediffDef.label: bee stings
HediffDef.description: A sting or two on the hand from working the beehouses: a hot, swollen hand that throbs for a day. Nothing worse ever comes of it. A beekeeper who knows animals is stung far less (a quarter as often from Animals 15 on); slow, calm hands at the hives are the whole secret.

li.gotText: The bees stung {PAWN_nameDef} on the hand at the beehouse.

gotTexts.li: [again] The bees got {PAWN_nameDef} again, on the same hand.
[summer] The bees were busy and short-tempered, and {PAWN_nameDef} came away from the beehouse stung.

notes.li: Scrape the sting out, cold water on it, and it'll be down by tomorrow.
[lowtech] Scrape the sting out with a thumbnail, a dab of mud or honey on it, and leave it be.
[!lowtech] Scrape the sting out, a cold pack, and something for the itch. It's gone in a day.
